title: Remote Image
summary: In-place L1 feature pack: a fixed URL-keyed table that fetches, decodes and uploads small images as textures, evicts the least recently touched entry that is not frame-hot, caches failures negatively on two retry schedules and caps its concurrent fetches. Every limit arrives through its config; the pack has no notion of what the images are.
dependencies: engine nt_time for the retry clock
provides: remote_image_state and remote_image_get: PENDING, READY or FAILED per URL, a texture only when READY
LRU eviction that never drops an entry touched in the current frame
negative cache: transient failures and missing resources retried on separate delays
a concurrency cap so the shared http slots are not starved
decoded images fitted to a maximum dimension by area average
remote_image_backend_t: transport, decoder, GPU and clock behind one seam

flags.testing: REMOTE_IMAGE_TESTING drops the engine backend from the link so the table builds against a canned one

registers.note: Describes the template's existing in-place wiring.
